title: Two Injured In Andrew County Accident - NewsBreak
text:
21 hours ago Two occupants of one of the vehicles involved in a two-vehicle accident Tuesday evening were taken to the hospital. The Missouri State Highway Patrol reports a 58-year-old St Joseph male driver was traveling southbound on U.S. 169 Highway just north of St Joseph in Andrew County and failed to yield to another vehicle while attempting a right turn on a county road. His vehicle struck the front left wheelwell of the other vehicle, driven by a 49-year-old St Joseph male driver. Both vehicles came to a controlled stop following the impact. The 49-year-old male driver and a 48-year-old female riding in the vehicle both received minor injuries and were taken to Mosaic by private vehicle. Read full article
